definitions.full: H4861. Mishal מִשְׁאָל proper name, of a location in Asher (Egyptian Mi-ša'a-ra WMM As.u.Eur.181 ); — Josh 19:26 ( ᵐ5 Μαασα , A Μασαψ , ᵐ5 L Μασαλ 21:30 ( ᵐ5 Βασελλαν , A Μασααλ , ᵐ5 L Μισαλα ); = (1.) מָשָׁל 1Chr 6:59 ( ᵐ5 Μαασα , A Μασαλ , ᵐ5 L Μασιλ ). [ מִשְׁאָלָה ] see שׁאל

occurrences.englishText: Allammelech, Amad, Mishal. It reached to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath.
Out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,
